examples.title: Register with DI

sections.title: Dependency injection
sections.text: See [`Lyo.Compression`](../Lyo.Compression/README.md) for keyed services, `ICompressionResolver`, and `CompressionOptions` in appsettings.json. **File storage reads:** register `AddBZip2Compressor()` when stored metadata may reference BZip2; [ `ICompressionResolver`](../Lyo.Compression/README.md#icompressionresolver-per-algorithm-dispatch) decompresses by metadata on read.
